metadata.title: The Scheduler Free-Energy Certificate: A One-Step Audit of Anti-Starvation Research Selection
metadata.description: A formally verified one-step certificate for maximum-age selection under an equal-cost deterministic reset model, paired with a reproducible audit of a versioned research-scheduling policy. The policy proposal remains unadopted, and the paper does not claim long-run optimality, empirical productivity, or execution authority.
metadata.notes: The release includes the final reconciled paper, deterministic 22-check replay, exact policy and state inputs, pinned Lean environment, six-theorem zero-sorry audit, provenance, and checksums. Publication does not adopt or authorize the included policy proposal.
